notes: The accidental deaths reported during 1978 have been further analysed according to age group of the victims. On the all-India level, the maximum number of accidental deaths occurred in the age group of 18-30 years which accounted for 35 · 1 percent of the total accidental deaths followed by age group 30-50 years which shared 27 · 6 percent of the total accidental deaths. 23 · 5 percent of the total accidental deaths occurred in the age group below 18 years and 13 · 8 percent deaths were recorded in the age group above 50 years.

The composition of accidental deaths according to age group in the States as a whole did not vary much from the all-India average and in the U. Ts. and Metropolitan Cities also the percentage of the different age groups indicated the same pattern.
